nodes.description: Address of the contract owner stored by OwnableUpgradeable; controls access to onlyOwner guarded functions such as _setOwner and _authorizeUpgrade.
Mapping of account balances updated by _mint, _transfer and _burn; primary accounting state of the token.
Total token supply; increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Initializable flag that records whether the proxy implementation has already been initialized; gate for the initialize() function.
Immutable address(this) stored by UUPSUpgradeable and used by onlyProxy to verify the call is proxied to this implementation.
Public initializer that sets token metadata, transfers ownership context and mints the full 50,000,000 token supply to the receiver.
Overridden UUPS authorization hook restricted by onlyOwner; gates upgradeTo and upgradeToAndCall.
External UUPS upgrade entry point guarded by onlyProxy that calls _authorizeUpgrade then _upgradeToAndCallSecure.
Payable UUPS upgrade entry point guarded by onlyProxy that authorizes and then executes an arbitrary delegatecall payload after the upgrade.
Internal ERC20 mint that increases _totalSupply and the recipient balance; invoked during initialize with an owner-controlled amount.
Public ERC20 transfer that moves tokens from _msgSender() to a recipient and updates _balances.
Public burn that consumes the caller's allowance and destroys tokens from the target account; performs an unchecked allowance subtraction.
Private owner setter that writes the _owner state variable and emits OwnershipTransferred.
OwnableUpgradeable access-control modifier comparing owner() with _msgSender() and reverting otherwise.
msg.sender exposed through _msgSender(); attacker-controllable caller identity used for ownership and allowance checks.
Unprotected state-changing mint performed inside initialize, writing _totalSupply and _balances without an owner restriction on the receiver argument.
Low-level delegatecall to an implementation address controlled by the upgrade path; executes arbitrary code in the proxy storage context.
Unchecked allowance subtraction in burnFrom (currentAllowance - amount) that relies on a preceding require for safety.
Address parameter of initialize that receives the initial 50,000,000 token mint.
Address parameter of upgradeTo, upgradeToAndCall and _authorizeUpgrade naming the new implementation to delegate calls to.
uint256 amount parameter used by burnFrom, transfer and _mint for value movement.
Address parameter of burnFrom identifying the account whose tokens are burned.
Local variable caching the caller allowance before the checked unchecked subtraction in burnFrom.
Local flag in the initializer modifier that decides whether _initializing/_initialized must be toggled for the call.
Local variable in _upgradeToAndCallSecure holding the previous implementation for the rollback delegatecall test.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed through _msgSender() as newOwner when ownership is set or transferred.
msg.sender is compared against owner() inside onlyOwner; a spoofed or front-run caller would defeat the ownership gate.
onlyOwner gates execution of the _authorizeUpgrade hook, restricting who may authorize implementation changes.
onlyOwner gates the owner-transfer path that reaches _setOwner.
upgradeTo invokes _authorizeUpgrade before performing the upgrade, making the owner check the access-control barrier.
upgradeToAndCall invokes _authorizeUpgrade before upgrading and executing the payload.
The newImplementation address flows into _authorizeUpgrade, which decides whether the caller may replace the proxy logic.
newImplementation flows into upgradeTo and is later used as the delegatecall target.
newImplementation flows into upgradeToAndCall and is used as the delegatecall target for the post-upgrade call.
upgradeTo reaches the low-level delegatecall executed inside _upgradeToAndCallSecure/_functionDelegateCall.
upgradeToAndCall reaches the low-level delegatecall with attacker-supplied data after authorization.
oldImplementation is encoded into the rollback delegatecall payload used to re-enter upgradeTo on the new implementation.
The _initialized flag is read by the initializer modifier so initialize can only run once, guarding first-call ownership/mint setup.
isTopLevelCall in the initializer modifier decides how the _initializing/_initialized flags are toggled around initialize.
initialize directly performs the initial mint operation to bootstrap the total supply.
The receiver argument determines the beneficiary of the initial 50,000,000 token mint.
The mint writes the minted amount into the _balances mapping for the receiver.
The mint increases _totalSupply by amount; uncapped minting arithmetic is performed at initialization.
_mint reads and increments the _balances entry of the mint recipient.
_mint adds amount to _totalSupply, the supply arithmetic that can be abused if minting stays unrestricted.
_transfer debit and credit the _balances mapping of sender and recipient.
The amount argument controls how many tokens the transfer moves between balances.
currentAllowance is the value subtracted by amount inside burnFrom's unchecked block.
burnFrom executes the unchecked allowance subtraction, which would underflow if the preceding require were removed.
burnFrom reduces the _balances entry of the burning account.
burnFrom indirectly reduces _totalSupply through _burn's supply arithmetic.
amount drives the allowance subtraction and burn quantity inside burnFrom.
The account argument selects whose allowance and balance burnFrom consumes.

normalization_plan.reason: receiver is a non-core parameter used only by initialize to designate the initial mint beneficiary and carries no independent security semantics.
newImplementation is a non-core parameter whose trust decision is made entirely by the onlyOwner-gated _authorizeUpgrade hook.
amount is a non-core parameter that only parameterizes the arithmetic performed by the burnFrom/unchecked subtraction path.
account is a non-core parameter that only selects the balance and allowance touched by burnFrom.
currentAllowance exists solely to feed the unchecked allowance subtraction operation inside burnFrom.
isTopLevelCall is a modifier-local flag whose only effect is toggling the initialization flags around the initialize call.
oldImplementation is a local used only to build the rollback delegatecall payload during the upgrade procedure.
